title: CGAP Human Oesophagus Epithelium Dissociation
author: Adam Hunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qz8dx9w
materials: Count cells and viability using nucleocounter.

Ensure all unused tissue, equipment and tubes that have been in contact with primary tissue are placed into Virkon in sweetie jar for a minimum of 1 hour. After this time aspirate and disposing in relevant sharps or waste routes.

steps.title: Wash samples with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse each oesophagus sample with 10 ml cold PBS to remove residual contamination, stomach contents, and loose mucus.

steps.title: Place oesophagus in petri dish with PBS
steps.instruction: Transfer the oesophagus onto a 100 mm glass petri dish and add an additional 10 ml fresh cold PBS.

steps.title: Open and separate epithelium
steps.instruction: Open the samples longitudinally; the epithelium appears as a loose, yellowish layer on the lumen side. Using two forceps, separate the epithelium from the stroma and place the epithelium onto a separate 100 mm petri dish containing 10 ml PBS (process epithelium only).

steps.title: Finely mince epithelium in PBS
steps.instruction: In approximately 200 µl of PBS droplets, finely mince the epithelium with two scalpels simultaneously, avoiding excess PBS which hinders mincing.

steps.title: Add Trypsin‑EDTA and transfer tissue
steps.instruction: Add 4 ml Trypsin‑EDTA (0.25 %) to the minced tissue, then transfer the mixture to a 50 ml Falcon tube. Wash the scalpels and the petri dish with an additional 1 ml Trypsin‑EDTA (0.25 %) and add this wash to the Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 ml Trypsin‑EDTA (0.25 %) to the dish.
Transfer tissue to a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Wash scalpel and dish with 1 ml Trypsin‑EDTA (0.25 %) and add to the tube.

steps.title: Incubate digestion at 37°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the Falcon tube for 30 min at 37 °C on a rocker to allow enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Add DNase I and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNase I dropwise to achieve a final concentration of 100 µg ml⁻¹, then incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Neutralize trypsin with RPMI + FBS
steps.instruction: Add 20 ml RPMI medium supplemented with 20 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) to inactivate the trypsin.

steps.title: Centrifuge low‑speed to pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 200 g for 2 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Filter cells through 70 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer into a fresh 50 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash to reach 30 ml total volume
steps.instruction: Wash the Falcon tube and the strainer with 5 ml RPMI + 20 % FBS, then add an additional 25 ml RPMI + 20 % FBS so the total volume becomes 30 ml (5 ml trypsin carry‑over + 25 ml fresh media).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml RPMI + 20 % FBS to the tube and strainer.
Add further 25 ml RPMI + 20 % FBS to reach 30 ml total.

steps.title: Centrifuge 500 g, 5 min, 4°C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cells with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 5 ml cold PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge again 500 g, 5 min, 4°C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the PBS wash at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml Red Cell Lysis buffer to the pellet and resuspend by gently tapping or racking.

steps.title: Ice incubation with agitation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 5 min, gently agitating periodically.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge post‑lysis
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml cold PBS, then centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min; remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in PBS with BSA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA (equivalent to 8 µl BSA per ml PBS).

steps.title: Final filtration through 70 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 70 µm cell strainer to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Assess viability and remove dead cells if needed
steps.instruction: If live‑cell percentage is >70‑80 %, proceed to scRNA‑seq; if <70‑80 %, perform dead‑cell removal using the CGAP Dead Cell Removal EasySep kit with the Big Easy Magnet.

steps.title: Dilute to 2×10⁶ cells/ml for 10X
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell concentration to 2 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ in 0.04 % BSA and continue with the 10X Genomics single‑cell RNA‑sequencing workflow.
